subject: phase3_input_cost_containment
statement: Correct the transcript interpretation while retaining the completed decision to reject Phase 3 expansion under the measured containment policy.
selected_option: treat complete Codex JSONL output as operator evidence, attribute the measured regression to cumulative multi-round input rather than unproven failure of per-tool truncation, and retain the budget stop

alternatives.option: retain the claim that all JSONL command output entered model context
alternatives.rejected_reason: Codex applies tool output truncation when recording model history and may retain a fuller execution event, so JSONL byte length alone does not support that claim.

alternatives.option: discard the cost-screen conclusion because one mechanism was misinterpreted
alternatives.rejected_reason: Provider usage, 41 completed tool calls, the 10.4196 direct-to-single ratio, and the aggregate budget stop remain valid evidence that the policy did not contain cumulative cost.

rationale: The treatment direct transcript contains 38 completed commands and 3 file changes, but complete event output is not identical to model-visible history. Codex source and tests apply tool_output_token_limit while recording function output. The direct worker nevertheless reported 2754757 input tokens and 2625536 cached input tokens over 41 tool calls. The corrected mechanism is repeated sampling over a growing history: per-tool truncation can be effective while cumulative provider input still becomes excessive. This correction narrows the causal explanation without changing the observed cost failure or the decision not to expand.
expected_outcome: Preserve accurate cost evidence and require a cumulative context and tool-round boundary before another scored execution.
acceptance_refs: provider-free replay counts completed command_execution and file_change events
no new provider call is authorized by this correction
